mostWorthwhile.text: The second pair of hands steadying the carrier and the quiet response to the folded limbs made the discovery feel shared and consequential.

leastWorthwhile.text: There was no action to take in this chapter, so it felt more like an epilogue than a playable conclusion.

surprise.text: The restrained silence at the receiving laboratory was striking after the long effort to preserve the specimen.

arbitrary.text: No gameplay actions were offered in this chapter, so none felt arbitrary.

continue.text: I would be curious to see what the laboratory learns about the body, though this ending already provides a quiet sense of closure.
